restore.scope: Logical rows, compressed artifact bytes, frozen query identity, and retained complete-result counts; restoration, full result hashes, HTTP routes and recovery timings are separate operator steps.
restore.recovery_timing_scope: Conservative wall-clock upper bound from R2 restore invocation through confirmed restored browser, full worker recomputation, and statistics checks; includes manual review, unrelated checks and a repeated measurement run. Database/object restoration alone is restore_seconds.

bucket_privacy.verified_with: authenticated Wrangler read-only bucket configuration commands

notes: The full backup/restore used existing local PostgreSQL17.11 and actual private R2 storage.
Restore downloaded into a separate directory and did not read original objects.
Application browser journeys passed against the restored database on Python3.12.13. Worker recomputation verification is recorded separately.
R2 request totals count SDK operations; SDK retries may add HTTP requests.
Native ARM and hosted throughput remain unverified.
